items.description:
Clicks Sunnyside is a health, beauty and pharmacy branch, store number 305, inside Sunnypark Shopping Centre in Sunnyside, Pretoria. The store runs a full pharmacy dispensary alongside Clicks' usual range of makeup, skincare, haircare and personal care products, along with everyday retail items such as baby care, vitamins and household essentials.

As part of the national Clicks chain, the branch gives Sunnyside shoppers access to a pharmacist on site for prescriptions, health advice and over-the-counter medication, alongside the retail side of the store for everyday shopping. Clicks Sunnyside trades from Sunnypark Shopping Centre on Greef Street, Trevenna, Pretoria, Monday to Friday from 09:00 to 18:00, Saturdays from 09:00 to 17:00 and Sundays from 09:00 to 14:00.

Clubview Laundry offers laundry and dry cleaning services from Clubview Corner, on the corner of Lyttelton and Harvard Roads, Clubview, Centurion, including standard wash, dry and iron services using SABS-approved detergents and stain removers. Dirty laundry dropped off in the morning can typically be collected clean the same afternoon.

Dry cleaning is handled through both the traditional PERC process and an environmentally friendly wet-cleaning system, with garments quality-checked at every step. The business also cleans carpets of all sizes, alters clothing, cleans and preserves wedding gowns, and cleans curtains, blankets and duvets, giving customers a single laundry and textile-care provider for household items beyond everyday clothing.

Constantia Guest Lodge is a wine-farm-themed guest house in Meyerspark with seven Cape Dutch-styled en-suite rooms, each named after a wine varietal, set around an elegant Cape Dutch exterior meant to evoke a sense of tranquility. Rooms such as the Chardonnay Family En-Suite include a queen-size double bed, a television with DSTV, and tea and coffee making facilities.

Guests can relax on the veranda with a drink or use the free WiFi to keep up with work or family, before retreating to their room and waking to a complimentary breakfast. The lodge serves business travellers, tourists and visitors coming to see friends and family, operating from Emmarentia Street in Meyerspark, Pretoria.

Cordys Africa is a Pretoria-based software development company providing IT solutions for the agricultural sector, with custom software developed for the broiler, broiler breeder, commercial layer and feed mill markets, including its Avihance poultry management and Millstone+ feed mill products. The company works as a small, focused team rather than a large corporate developer, building software using a stack that includes C#, the ASP dotNET framework, MS SQL and Google App Engine.

Its stated values include accountability, integrity, social responsibility, respect, balance, innovation and teamwork, and the business positions its work as making a real difference to the livelihoods of people in the agricultural sector rather than software for its own sake. Cordys Africa operates from Protea Street in Roodeplaat, Leeuwfontein, Pretoria, serving poultry and feed mill clients.

Creative Condos is a prefabricated timber and modular construction company based in Montana, Pretoria, offering Nutec wendy houses, tiny homes, log cabins, garden studios, decking, and prefab classrooms and offices built using timber frame and insulated panel systems. The company's team draws on an engineering background and more than 16 years spent refining its construction systems and quality standards for timber and Nutec building work.

Nutec tiny homes in particular are marketed around their smaller size, which the company says lowers both the purchase cost and ongoing maintenance and utility costs compared with a conventional house. Creative Condos operates from Moepel Road, Montana, Pretoria, serving clients across South Africa who want a prefabricated timber or Nutec structure built to a high finish.

Daisy Business Solutions is a South African technology services provider with over 40 years in business, connecting, securing, powering and financing businesses across eight divisions covering connectivity, telecoms, IT managed services, software, business security, print and document solutions, solar and energy systems, and business finance. Rather than tying clients to a single manufacturer, the company recommends whichever technology actually fits a business, sourced from leading vendors and delivered under one service level agreement, one invoice and one point of contact.

Daisy also finances the technology it supplies, letting a business put the right equipment in place immediately rather than waiting through several budget cycles, and stands behind every sale with ongoing support. The company holds recognition including Canon Partner of the Year 2026 and Yeastar Titanium Partner status, serving businesses nationwide.

Delugo | The Happy Food Co. is a frozen ready-made meals manufacturer in Hennopspark, Centurion, describing itself as 'comfort food for modern taste buds'. Its menu spans beef, chicken, pasta, pizza and pie categories, with individual dishes such as chicken nuggets, meatballs and fettuccine in a sundried tomato basil pesto sauce, and sides including golden pumpkin fritters served with caramel sauce.

The company also offers family meal boxes delivered across Gauteng, giving households a way to stock a freezer with home-style meals without cooking from scratch each night. Delugo operates from Hilda Avenue in Hennopspark, Centurion, Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 17:00 and Saturdays from 09:00 to 13:00.

Deo Swanepoel Properties is a Pretoria-based real estate agency registered with the PPRA, handling the sale, purchase and rental of residential and commercial property across northern Pretoria suburbs including Magalieskruin, Montana, Silverton and Doornpoort. The agency's dedicated sales team works alongside an in-house home loan specialist, who advises on and assists with bond applications and approvals to make the financing side of a purchase less stressful.

The agency's listings have included family homes and townhouses in Doornpoort and Sinoville, reflecting its focus on the northern Pretoria property market rather than the city as a whole. Deo Swanepoel Properties operates from Airport Road in Doornpoort, Pretoria, offering free property evaluations to prospective sellers.

Deposita is a cash management technology company providing smart safes, cash recycling machines, banknote disinfection cabinets and the Connector SaaS platform for retail, wholesale and banking clients. Its retail solutions automate reliable, safe cash transactions and customer-to-bank cash management, guarding smaller stores and national franchises alike against errors, shrinkage and theft, while its wholesale-grade safes handle high-speed, bulk cash processing with multiple automated payments.

In banking, Deposita automates and safeguards cash processing through self-service or assisted-service channels built to international standards, serving retail and commercial banks and financial institutions. The company holds ISO 27001 and ISO 9001:2015 certification and operates as part of the Allied Universal group, from its base near Blue Valley Golf Estate, Centurion.

Die Byenes is a stationery, printing and personal branding business in Jan Niemand Park, Pretoria, offering custom printing, stickers and labels, sublimation products such as personalised mugs and bottles, and laser-cut signs, decor and custom shapes. Customers can browse products and variants, request a custom quote for bespoke printing or branding work, and pay securely online through Yoco or EFT.

Orders come with automated invoices and packing slips generated through the website, and the shop also stocks general stationery and school supplies alongside its printing and branding services. Die Byenes operates from Jan Coetzee Street in Jan Niemand Park, Pretoria, taking orders online or via WhatsApp for both everyday stationery and custom branded items.

Die Grashut is a thatching and construction company established in 1996, offering thatch roof installation and repairs, building and renovation work, custom lapas and pergolas, fire retardant treatment and lightning protection systems. The company has grown to operate from branches in both Pretoria and Upington, giving it reach across two different regions of South Africa rather than a single local area.

Fire retardant treatment and lightning protection are offered alongside standard thatching work, addressing two of the particular risks that come with a thatch roof rather than leaving clients to source those services separately. Die Grashut operates from Lavender Road, Wonderboom, Pretoria, serving clients who want a thatched lapa, pergola or full roof built or maintained.

Digit Technologies is a Pretoria-based IT solutions provider operating since 2005, offering cloud and web hosting, Office 365 reselling, Omni Accounts and ERP software reselling, cloud backup and security services, hosted VOIP and PBX systems, and on-site and remote IT support. This combination of hosting, software reselling and support work lets a business manage most of its core technology needs through a single provider rather than juggling separate vendors for each service.

Having operated for close to two decades, the company has built up experience supporting small and medium businesses through the kind of day-to-day technology issues that come with running on cloud-based systems and hosted communications. Digit Technologies operates from 30th Avenue in Villieria, Pretoria, serving businesses across the city.

Digital Zoo is a web design and digital marketing agency based in The Wilds, Pretoria, offering website design and development, search engine optimisation, social media optimisation, domain registration and business email hosting. The company registers each client under its own company and VAT numbers, and provides online support channels for Windows, MacOS and Android users who need technical help with their systems.

Digital Zoo manages content updates, security maintenance and analytics reporting for client websites on an ongoing basis, rather than handing over a finished site with no further involvement. The company operates from Sandolien Street, The Wilds, Pretoria, Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 17:00, closed on weekends and public holidays.

DIY Depot Ryneveld is a branch of the DIY Depot hardware and building-supplies chain, which operates more than 140 stores across South Africa stocking cement, bricks, sand, timber and other building materials. The chain carries well-known brands including Plascon, AfriSam, Academy, Ellies, Efekto, Gardena, Jojo, Marley and Woodoc, giving customers a wide choice of trusted names under one roof.

Beyond standard hardware, DIY Depot publishes DIY hints and tips for seasonal projects such as patio makeovers and winter painting work, aimed at helping customers tackle projects themselves rather than only selling materials. This branch trades from the Ryneveld Corner Centre in Pierre van Ryneveld Park, Centurion, with delivery services available for building materials.

Drake Events is an event management company with more than a decade of experience delivering corporate functions, property development launches, hospitality experiences and promotional activations across South Africa. Its specialist divisions cover event management, hospitality and bar services through Drinks by Drake, promotional staffing through Staff by Drake, and styling and decor through Styling by Drake, letting clients draw on one or several of these services for a single event.

The company positions its reputation around consistency, honest communication and dependable service rather than one-off, high-pressure event delivery, aiming to build long-term relationships with repeat corporate clients. Drake Events operates from Jacques Street in Moreleta Park, Pretoria, serving corporate and private clients across the city.

E-Connect has operated as an electrical contractor in South Africa since 1995, registered with the Electrical Contractors Association and the Electrical Conformance Board, and CIDB certified at EB6 and EP6 level for projects valued at more than R15 million. The company's in-house estimating and project controls teams work across residential, commercial and industrial projects, with a delivery model that can involve early contractor input from the initial design phase through to construction, testing, commissioning and handover.

With more than two decades of project execution and management experience, E-Connect is headquartered in Kilner Park, Pretoria, with an additional depot in Willow Park Manor, and also offers solar installation services alongside its core electrical contracting work.

Easy Lift Transport Crane and Truck Hire, founded in 1996, provides heavy lifting and transport services in Pretoria and Gauteng, including generator and machinery transport, palm tree and cycad relocation, light aircraft recovery, and steel structure erection. The business started with a single truck moving palm trees and cycads before expanding into contract work for the City of Tshwane, erecting high-voltage power lines and street lighting.

Word of its wider capabilities spread, leading to work placing generators for large companies and later more specialised recovery and transport of light aircraft. Easy Lift describes itself as proudly accident-free, and now offers local and long-distance loads with transport available nationwide, with a strong focus on Pretoria, Johannesburg and the greater Gauteng area.

Elardus Park MIDAS is a branch of the Midas automotive parts retail chain, southern Africa's largest privately owned automotive parts retailer and wholesaler, stocking spare parts, car care products and accessories including seat covers, car covers, cleaning and detailing products, and phone and security accessories for vehicles. The branch gives customers access to Midas's full accessories and car-care range alongside its usual spares counter.

Trading from the Elardus Park Shopping Centre on Barnard Street, the branch serves customers across Elardus Park and the surrounding suburbs, open Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 19:00, Saturdays from 08:00 to 15:00 and Sundays from 09:00 to 13:00.

The Election Management Consulting Agency of Africa (EMCA) is a Pretoria-based independent specialist consultancy focused on elections, providing legitimate election processes for sectors of the economy that require them, alongside expert planning, organising, coordination and execution of professional independent private elections. The agency builds a system of checks and balances intended to make an election process inclusive, transparent and credible, leaving clients and stakeholders satisfied with the result.

Its services extend to election materials supply and election campaign management, along with political strategy consulting and a Women in Politics programme, giving EMCA a role in both running elections and supporting the people standing in them. The agency operates from Havelock Road in Willow Park Manor, Pretoria, serving clients across Africa.

Elite Wealth Technology Solutions is a Pretoria-based software company, founded in 2008, providing a web-based practice management system for financial advisors built around client and practice management, client portfolio and reporting, financial planning, business intelligence and third-party integrations. The platform is designed to give financial advisory businesses a single system for managing clients and their information rather than separate tools for each task.

Its business intelligence tools are meant to help advisors make data-driven decisions, while automated data feeds and reporting and third-party integrations streamline the back-office side of running an advisory practice. Elite Wealth Technology Solutions operates from Boardwalk Office Park in Faerie Glen, Pretoria, serving financial advisors across South Africa.

ERA Real Estate South Africa is part of the ERA Group, a residential real estate franchise brokerage network operating in South Africa since 1972, offering property sales and rental services for houses, apartments, townhouses, commercial properties, farms and vacant land. The brand's website lets buyers search listings by price range for both sales and rentals, alongside tools such as a bond calculator and email alerts for new listings matching a buyer's criteria.

ERA also offers franchise opportunities to agents wanting to operate under an established, long-running brand rather than starting an independent agency from scratch. ERA Real Estate South Africa operates from Highveld Techno Park in Centurion, serving buyers, sellers, landlords and tenants across the region.

ERESA specialises in emergency and specialised vehicle conversions, including custom ambulances, security and mobile clinic vehicles, LED lightbars, sirens and safety equipment, serving police, medical, security, construction and mining sectors. All assembly and engineering work is carried out locally at the company's own facility in Koedoespoort, Pretoria, rather than importing converted vehicles.

This local assembly and engineering capability lets ERESA adapt a conversion to a client's specific operational requirements, whether that is a mobile clinic for a rural health programme or a security vehicle fitted with particular lighting and siren equipment. ERESA operates from Eland Street, Koedoespoort Industrial, Pretoria, Monday to Friday from 07:30 to 16:30.

Evetech has built and sold PC systems since 2007, working with major component brands including Intel, AMD, NVIDIA, ASUS and MSI, with its Centurion store at Limeroc Business Park on Holland Road offering in-store and online sales, custom PC assembly, and repair and onsite services. Customers can reach the sales or technical support team by phone or email, with technical queries typically answered within 24 hours.

Free parking is available on site at the Centurion store, making it straightforward for customers to drop off or collect a PC in person rather than relying on courier delivery alone. Evetech trades from Holland Road (R114), Centurion, Monday to Friday from 09:00 to 16:00 and Saturdays from 09:00 to 12:00, closed Sundays and public holidays.

Eztax CC is an accounting firm based in Erasmia, Centurion, offering accounting, tax registrations and submissions, CIPC company registration and amendments, and will planning and deceased estate administration. The firm states it has provided financial services for over 13 years, covering the kind of administrative and compliance work that a small business or individual needs beyond standard bookkeeping.

By combining company registration and amendment work with estate and will planning, Eztax gives clients a single point of contact for both business compliance matters and personal estate planning, rather than needing a separate firm for each. Eztax operates from Helena Street in Erasmia, Centurion, serving individuals and small businesses in the area.

Firwood Lodge is a TGCSA 4-star graded guesthouse in Hazelwood offering en-suite rooms finished with porcelain tiles, solid wood and leather furniture, large flat-screen televisions and eco-friendly air conditioning. The property includes an outdoor pool with a tanning deck, a bar, a fitness room, uncapped fibre internet and a large three-phase backup generator, so guests are not left without power or connectivity.

All stays include shuttle, laundry and room services, and the lodge sits about 20 metres from The Village Centre, home to restaurants such as Salt, Bistro Blackmore and Alfies, with Menlyn and Brooklyn malls around a ten-minute drive away. Firwood Lodge has been welcoming guests in the area for over a decade, operating from Firwood Avenue in Hazelwood, Pretoria.

Fourier IT is an IT services and consulting company in Die Hoewes, Centurion, trading since 1998, offering solution advisory and architecture to help businesses optimise their digital platforms and systems, alongside custom software development and seamless system integrations built around each client's specific needs. Its IT support and maintenance service provides a dedicated support team to manage a client's systems and networks, letting the client focus on their core business instead.

Fourier IT also implements future-focused technology tools and products aimed at long-term business sustainability, and offers business process management solutions designed to drive efficiency and support continuous innovation. The company serves clients in the financial, engineering and mining sectors from its base in Die Hoewes, Centurion.

Gerneke & Potgieter Attorneys is a Pretoria North law firm established in 1995, specialising in conveyancing and registered on the panels of all four major commercial banks. The firm's partners bring a combined total of more than 49 years practising law and more than 37 years specifically in conveyancing, giving the practice depth of experience in property transfer work beyond what a newer firm could offer.

Ideally situated and accessible from major routes, the firm's practice areas extend beyond conveyancing to estate litigation, civil law, estate planning and divorce law. Gerneke & Potgieter Attorneys operates from Danie Theron Street in Pretoria North, serving clients across the northern Pretoria area.

GM Anchor Group is a digital marketing and IT company in Heritage Hill Estate offering SEO, social media management and paid advertising alongside IT services such as cybersecurity and process optimisation, plus a Leadership & Innovation Hub for business-growth training. The company also runs an investment-facing arm connecting investors with pre-screened, high-potential African businesses, supported by due diligence and post-investment portfolio support.

For entrepreneurs, GM Anchor Group offers branding, marketing and funding-readiness support to help a business present itself credibly to investors or lenders, while its corporate-facing services cover supplier development, compliance and CSR initiatives. GM Anchor Group operates from Brakfontein Road in Heritage Hill Estate, Pretoria, serving entrepreneurs, corporates and investors across the region.

Go2 Accounting is an accounting and bookkeeping practice, established in 2016, that focuses on personalised service for small and medium-sized businesses, offering Xero and Sage implementation, monthly bookkeeping, payroll and full SARS tax compliance. The practice frames its work around real relationships rather than numbers alone, aiming to understand a client's business and the person behind it before recommending how to run its finances.

This relationship-first approach means many of the firm's clients stay on for years, moving from a standard client relationship into a more collaborative one as the practice gets to know a business's particular needs. Go2 Accounting operates from Garsfontein Office Park in Garsfontein, Pretoria, serving small and medium businesses across the city.

HCL Financial Services is an accounting practice based in Waterkloof Park offering bookkeeping, payroll and tax compliance services to Pretoria-area small and medium businesses, with particular experience serving tradesmen, construction and architectural firms, fuel stations, retailers, salons and hospitality operators. The practice focuses on established businesses that have traded for at least a full year, rather than brand-new start-ups.

Clients within about 25km of Pretoria East can be served in person, while businesses further afield across South Africa are supported fully online, with services covering monthly reconciliations, management accounts and VAT201 support, plus payroll services including payslips, EMP201 and UIF submissions. HCL Financial Services operates from Waterkloof Park, serving Pretoria East, Centurion, Midstream and the surrounding areas.

HENSOLDT GEW is the GEW Technologies business unit of HENSOLDT South Africa, a systems engineering company established in 1968 that designs, develops and supports electronic warfare, spectrum monitoring and security systems. HENSOLDT South Africa is HENSOLDT Group's largest industrial base outside Germany, with expertise spanning electromagnetic warfare, optronics, radar, IFF and datalinks, as well as spectrum management and security solutions.

With more than 60 years of innovation behind it, the company combines local engineering capability with the backing of HENSOLDT's international footprint, supplying defence forces, government institutions and spectrum management authorities. HENSOLDT GEW operates from De Havilland Crescent in Persequor, Pretoria, serving defence and civil markets that need mission-critical electronic systems.

HIMOINSA Southern Africa is part of the global HIMOINSA/Yanmar Group, supplying diesel, gas and hybrid generator sets ranging from 8kVA to 1275kVA, along with lighting towers, for standby, prime and peak power applications. Its rental division offers long-term, short-term and bridging generator solutions from 60kVA, while its power projects team engineers bespoke hybrid plants combining solar, gas and wind generation for more complex sites.

A 24/7, fully OEM-qualified technical team provides nationwide support, backed by OEM parts, maintenance and service contracts, and the company has built a reputation among clients for the reliability of the Doosan engines used across its generator range. HIMOINSA Southern Africa operates from Samrand Business Park in Kosmosdal, Centurion, serving clients across Southern and East Africa.

Inqaba Biotechnical Industries, trading as inqaba biotec, is a genomics company established in 2002 and based in Muckleneuk, offering DNA sequencing, oligonucleotide synthesis, SNP and methylation analysis, and bioinformatics services to researchers and laboratories. These services support work in fields such as medical research, agriculture and forensic science, where genetic analysis forms part of a wider study or diagnostic process.

The company also distributes life-science laboratory equipment and reagents from international manufacturers, giving South African researchers access to specialised lab supplies without needing to import them individually. Inqaba Biotechnical Industries operates from Justice Mahomed Street in Muckleneuk, Pretoria, serving universities, research institutions and laboratories across the region.

Intrinsyc Dzumba Group, trading as IDG Africa, is a black-owned systems integrator based in Doringkloof with more than 15 years of experience, providing IT services and consulting, professional training, systems engineering and renewable energy solutions. Its government and private-sector clients draw on this combination of IT integration and renewable energy work, which is less common among smaller systems integrators focused on IT alone.

The professional training arm lets IDG Africa build client staff capacity alongside the systems it installs, rather than leaving a client reliant purely on external support once a project is complete. Intrinsyc Dzumba Group operates from Amatola Road in Doringkloof, Centurion, Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 17:00.

Irene Farm is a working dairy farm that has operated since 1895 and has stayed in the same family for five generations, with two on-site restaurants, The Barn and The Deck, plus a farm shop and dairy tours for visitors. The farm operates as a cashless environment, accepting all major credit and debit cards, and asks visitors not to bring their own food or drinks since the farm is sustained by selling its own food, milk and beverages.

Beyond its restaurants, Irene Farm hosts weddings and functions at venues including Champion Field, Coachmans Bend and the Pavilion Shed, and has its own hotel for overnight stays. Irene Farm operates from Nellmapius Road in Irene, Centurion, drawing visitors for its farm history as well as its dining and function venues.

JG Refrigeration offers refrigeration, air conditioning, electrical and shop fitting services, with trained staff and the equipment, machinery and heavy-duty fleet needed to complete a project from start to finish. The company guarantees a professional and technically sound installation backed by complete after-sales service and maintenance, rather than leaving clients to find a separate contractor once a system is installed.

Operating 24 hours a day, seven days a week, JG Refrigeration aims to respond quickly to breakdowns and minimise disruption to a client's operations, getting systems running again in the shortest time possible. The company operates from Johnson Street in Andeon, Pretoria West, Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 17:00, with 24-hour emergency callout available.

JHC Power Solutions is a solar and electrical services provider based in Villieria, installing photovoltaic and solar panel systems alongside electrical wiring, repairs and certificate of compliance work. The business operates as both a solar energy company and a registered electrician, offering delivery, online booking and in-store shopping for customers who want to discuss a system before committing to an installation.

Reviewers of the business recommend it consistently, and the company has completed solar installation projects in the Montana Tuine area of Pretoria, giving it a track record of installed systems in the northern Pretoria suburbs specifically. JHC Power Solutions operates from 25th Avenue in Villieria, Pretoria, serving homes and businesses that want solar power or general electrical work done by one provider.

Jubilee Metals Group Plc is a diversified metals recovery company listed on the London Stock Exchange's AIM and the JSE's AltX, specialising in the recovery of platinum group metals, chrome, nickel and copper. Its operations span across southern Africa and Zambia, recovering these metals from surface material and tailings rather than only through conventional mining.

This recovery-focused model lets Jubilee Metals process material that earlier mining operations left behind, extracting further value from existing mine sites rather than relying solely on new extraction. Jubilee Metals Group's offices are based at Southdowns Ridge in Irene, Pretoria, serving as a base for its operations across the region.

LEO Consulting is a civil consulting engineering firm established in 2008, with engineering staff carrying more than 100 years of combined experience across roads, bridges and civil works, water and sanitation infrastructure, buildings and structures, geotechnical work and GIS services. This breadth of disciplines under one firm means a client can commission related civil and structural work without coordinating between several separate consultancies.

The firm's GIS services support the mapping and spatial-data side of civil projects, complementing its more traditional engineering design work on roads, bridges and water infrastructure. LEO Consulting operates from Cobham Road in Queenswood, Pretoria, serving public and private sector clients across the region who need civil engineering consulting.

With no citable source of any kind, a researched description cannot be written.

items.description:
LIAFIN Professional Accountants and Tax Practitioners traces back to an accounting practice founded in 1993, and became an accredited SAIPA training centre in 2014, offering tailored accounting and tax services to individuals, sole traders, partnerships, close corporations, trusts and companies. The practice has experience across sectors including the motor industry, steel industry, food industry, building industry and insurance industry, rather than specialising in just one.

As a SAIPA training centre, LIAFIN also develops new accountants through its own training programme, which the practice draws on to keep its own service standards current with the profession's requirements. LIAFIN operates from Bush Road in Willow Park Manor, Pretoria, serving clients from a range of South African industries.

Founded in 1979, Loadcell Services is South Africa's largest manufacturer of locally made load cells, serving industries such as steel, mining, chemical processing, cement, and pulp and paper with static weighing, force measurement and overload-protection systems for cranes and conveyors. The company also specialises in torque and pressure measurement, and designs and manufactures accessories and instrumentation for the process automation industry.

In the iron and steel industry specifically, Loadcell Services has built up substantial experience in roll force measurement and the monitoring of strip tension, areas that call for specialised load cell applications beyond standard industrial weighing. Loadcell Services operates from N4 Gateway Business Park in The Willows, Pretoria, with most of its wide product range available for delivery from stock.

Logmex Global Trading, a subsidiary of TransCT Investments, provides supply chain management, logistics and import and export services, specialising in sourcing and distributing industrial consumables such as lubricants, sealants, adhesives, welding and soldering consumables, insulation materials, power capacitors and conveyor parts. This focus on industrial consumables means the company serves manufacturing and industrial clients needing a steady supply of parts that keep plant and machinery running, rather than finished consumer goods.

Being part of the wider TransCT Investments group gives Logmex access to broader supply chain and import infrastructure than a standalone distributor would typically have. Logmex Global Trading operates from Lanham Street in East Lynne, Pretoria, serving industrial and manufacturing clients across the region.

Lynx Real Estate is a property development company founded in 2016, drawing on around 50 years of combined joint-venture experience to source and execute property development projects, with a core focus on convenience retail centres anchored by strong national tenants. One of its completed projects, Lynnwood Lane in Equestria, is a shopping centre on Lynnwood Road designed around the needs of busy households, professionals and families.

The centre brings together grocery, health, beauty, food, home and lifestyle stores in one accessible location, letting visitors collect a prescription, shop for groceries, meet for a meal and run other errands in a single visit. Lynx Real Estate operates from Lynnwood Lane Retail Centre in Equestria, Pretoria, managing retail developments across the city.

Marietjie Prinsloo Properties is an estate agency established in 2001 and based in Lynnwood Ridge, Pretoria, serving the greater Pretoria East area including Lynnwood Ridge, Die Wilgers, Murrayfield, La Montagne, Equestria, Wapadrand, Faerie Glen, Moreletapark, Brummeria, Meyerspark, Silverton and Willow Park Manor along the N4 corridor. The agency's services include property sales, rentals, bond origination support and house hunting for buyers unfamiliar with the area.

A weekly photo show on Sundays lets buyers view available properties before arranging a private viewing, a format the agency has used consistently as part of its marketing. Marietjie Prinsloo Properties operates from Rubida Street in Murrayfield, Pretoria, serving the wider Pretoria East property market.

Masilo Nkwe is a real estate agent affiliated with eXp South Africa, specialising in new developments and residential property sales across Soshanguve, Rosslyn, Klerksoord, Pretoria North, Lotus Gardens and Mamelodi. Working under the eXp model gives the agent access to a national network and systems rather than operating as a fully independent sole trader.

With more than a decade of experience in the industry, the agent has built up local knowledge of the northern Pretoria and Mamelodi property markets specifically, an area not every Pretoria-wide agency focuses on. Masilo Nkwe operates from Heatherview Hills in Heatherdale, Akasia, serving buyers and sellers across the northern Pretoria and Mamelodi suburbs.

Mbeu Property Group is a 100% Black-owned firm offering property, engineering, construction, civil works, fuel supply and branding services, describing itself as one of South Africa's growing property companies with a fundamental objective to develop and invest in quality properties. The company holds SAFCEC registration across multiple CIDB grades as well as registration with the National Bargaining Council for the Electrical Industry.

This spread of registrations across construction and electrical bargaining councils reflects a business that moves between property development, civil works and supporting trades rather than specialising narrowly in one discipline. Mbeu Property Group operates from Stanza Bopape Street in Arcadia, Pretoria, taking on property and construction-related projects across the region.

Medical Resources Group is a healthcare management consultancy established in 2013, offering locum placements, permanent recruitment, practice sale marketing, practice management and malpractice insurance to medical practices. The consultancy positions itself as a trusted staffing brand for the healthcare sector, recognising that a practice's success depends on attracting, developing and retaining skilled healthcare professionals.

Its divisions cover talent acquisition, workforce planning, and strategies for employee engagement and retention, working with both community and corporate healthcare entities to create staffing approaches suited to each practice. Medical Resources Group is a Level 4 BBBEE contributor and a member of AHASA and APSO, operating from Crystal Corner on 24th Avenue in Villieria, Pretoria.

Medirite Mayville is part of the Medirite pharmacy chain, which operates within the Shoprite Checkers group across 144 stores nationwide, offering pharmaceuticals and medication at competitive prices with pharmacists registered with the South African Pharmacy Council on hand to assist. Customers can use the PrepMyScript service to pre-order chronic repeat medication from their phone and receive an SMS when it is ready to collect.

The branch accepts all major medical aid providers and lets customers get a script prepped while they shop for groceries at the adjoining Checkers or Shoprite store, along with in-store wellness screenings that can earn Vitality points. Medirite Mayville operates from Van Rensburg Street in Mayville, Pretoria, serving customers collecting both groceries and medication in one visit.

Mega Paints & Hardware in Mayville stocks a wide range of premium paints alongside brushes, primers, waterproofing products, skimming compounds, solvents, varnish and cleaning supplies, covering roof, wall, floor and ceiling paint needs plus the hardware to complete the job. The store positions itself as a specialist paint and hardware retailer rather than a general hardware chain, with stock chosen specifically around painting and surface preparation projects.

This focus allows the store to carry a deeper range of paint-related products, from priming and skimming compounds through to finishing varnishes, than a typical general hardware store would stock. Mega Paints & Hardware operates from Shop 11 on Paul Kruger Street in Mayville, Pretoria, serving painters and DIY customers across the Moot area.
